title: Exact Fock Amplitudes of the Cubic-Phase Gate on Arbitrary Pure Gaussian States
summary: The cubic phase gate is the only non-Gaussian element of universal continuous-variable quantum computation. Its Fock amplitudes are known in closed form only when the input is a Fock state. For a Gaussian input the usual route is to build the cubic quadrature in a truncated Fock space and exponentiate it, which alters the generator before the exponential is taken. A closed form is obtained here for every pure single-mode Gaussian input, with the squeezing along any quadrature axis and with arbitrary displacement and boost.
